summary:
Boon Edam, a global provider of physical security entrance solutions, has launched a new mobile full-height turnstile product aimed at construction sites and other temporary or evolving locations. The Turnlock 100 Mobile Platform mounts a full-height turnstile on a forklift-ready steel platform so it can be deployed, relocated and redeployed across different phases of a project without permanent installation, trenching or anchoring.

Patrick Nora, President and Managing Director of Boon Edam, framed the product around the shifting physical makeup of construction sites during various development stages, arguing that such environments require security solutions that are mobile and adaptive while still delivering high levels of physical security. He positions the offering as a versatile, proven solution for the construction industry's temporary deployment needs.

Functionally, the platform integrates with card readers, biometrics and other access control systems to prevent unauthorized entry and tailgating. The vendor cites growing pressure on construction teams around workforce accountability, site safety, compliance and theft prevention, particularly on large multi-phase projects with shifting perimeters and temporary access points.

Target use cases named include construction sites, temporary staging areas and infrastructure projects. The piece is essentially vendor product news published via FMLink, with no independent data, pricing, availability detail or customer references. The only quantified or named element is the product name itself. Readers are directed to Boon Edam for more on portable entry solutions for the construction industry.

Relevance to workplace technology audiences is limited to the access control and physical security entrance category rather than office visitor management, though the tailgating prevention and workforce accountability framing overlaps conceptually with onsite presence verification and credentialed entry.
